# LLVM attribution

`LICENSE.TXT` is the unmodified LLVM project license and legacy notice from
[LLVM 22.1.8](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llvm/llvm-project/llvmorg-22.1.8/llvm/LICENSE.TXT). Its SHA-256 is `8d85c1057d742e597985c7d4e6320b015a9139385cff4cbae06ffc0ebe89afee`.
Only attribution is stored here; SDK binaries and sources are selected through
`config/llvm_toolchain_releases.toml` and the existing SDK provisioner.
The release bundle and platform wheel include this notice beside the Molt license.
Actual static SDK input hashes are retained by the native-build receipt and SBOM.
